subject: Request: authorize ad-hoc credit + extension for Nebula Labs pilot
messages:
From: Jenna Lai <jenna@nebulalabs.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nebulalabs.com
Date: 2028-07-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot top-up + short extension request

Hi Sergio —

Our pilot with Redwood is scheduled to end next Tuesday, but usage projection shows we'll exceed the remaining allowance by ~35%. We'd like to request: (1) a one-time top-up of credits to cover the overage (estimate: $12,000 worth of credits), and (2) a 30-day extension to complete final integration tests.

Attached is the signed MOU and the Q2 usage export for your reference. Procurement (cc'ed) asked I follow your process for finance treatment: they prefer a credit memo applied as an invoice offset rather than a separate refund. Is that possible?

We can provide a PO if needed. Please advise next steps and ETA if this is approvable.

Thanks,
Jenna Lai
Head of Integrations, Nebula Labs
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: nebula_signed_mou.pdf
Attachment: usage_report_q2.csv

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Lai <jenna@nebulalabs.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot top-up + short extension request

Jenna — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the MOU / usage file. Looping in Aditya (sales owner) and Grace + Monica from finance/ops to confirm accounting path and timing.

Initial thoughts: can provision the 30-day extension immediately once we confirm the credit memo approach with finance. For the top-up, sales recommends $12k credits to cover the projected overage. Finance: can you confirm whether we should issue a credit memo (invoice offset) vs. booking this as promotional allowance? Also need GLA mapping and any PO/DocuSign token to attach.

Next steps (proposed):
- Grace: confirm ledger code and ETA to issue credit memo.
- Aditya: confirm final dollar amount to issue and whether this counts against promotional budget for Q3.
- Jenna/Procurement: if you can send a PO or sign a one-line DocuSign confirming offset application, that will speed the process.

Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

On Jul 11, 2028, Jenna Lai wrote: (see below)

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Jenna Lai <jenna@nebulalabs.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-11T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot top-up + short extension request

Thanks for looping me in. Confirming sales recommends a $12,000 credit top-up and a 30-day extension. Rationale: Nebula is near-production and the extra month materially increases chance of expansion. This would be an ad-hoc promotional credit, not a recurring commitment.

Ask for finance: please issue a credit memo for $12,000 to be applied as an invoice offset on Nebula's next invoice, or advise alternative workflow if month-end blocks offseting. HubSpot deal link attached: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/7892

If finance approves, I'll mark the credit as a promo allowance against my quarterly pool.

- Aditya
Sr. Account Manager, Redwood Inference

From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Jenna Lai <jenna@nebulalabs.com>
Date: 2028-07-11T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot top-up + short extension request

Thanks all — reviewed usage export and the signed MOU. Finance is OK with issuing a credit memo for $12,000 but we need the following to complete:

1) Formal PO or a signed DocuSign line referencing "apply as invoice offset" (we cannot net without customer authorization).
2) Confirmation of GL mapping: promotional allowance code 5421 preferred; if accounting requires different mapping for Nebula's industry class, let us know now.
3) Confirmation that the credit should be applied to the next outstanding invoice versus held as a customer credit balance.

Timing: once we have PO/DocuSign and confirmation, we can generate the credit memo within 3 business days. Note: if this crosses our month-end close (close date: 2028-07-31), we may need to tag the credit to the next period which impacts AR aging — advise if Nebula prefers immediate offset vs. post-close processing.

I've attached the usage CSV for our internal posting.

Grace O'Connor
Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai

Attachment: usage_report_q2.csv

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Lai <jenna@nebulalabs.com>, procurement@nebulalabs.com
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-12T16:44:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Approved credit memo + extension (next steps)

Jenna / Procurement — good news: finance has approved the requested $12,000 credit memo to be issued as an invoice offset. We will proceed on the following timeline and conditions:

- Action needed from Nebula: Please return a one-line DocuSign or a PO that states "Redwood to issue $12,000 credit memo to be applied as an offset to the next Redwood invoice." Procurement can send to finance@redwood.ai.
- Once we receive the DocuSign/PO, Redwood Finance (Grace) will create the credit memo within 3 business days and apply it to the next outstanding invoice per your preference.
- We will immediately extend Nebula's pilot environment for 30 days (no downtime) while finance processes the credit.

Summary of responsibilities:
- Nebula: PO/DocuSign confirmation (procurement@nebulalabs.com)
- Redwood Sales (Aditya/Sergio): confirm promo allowance booking to sales pool
- Redwood Finance (Grace/Monica): issue credit memo and post to AR (GL 5421 by default)

If procurement needs a billing contact or a sample one-line DocuSign text, Monica can send a template.

Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
